name: Halyard
title: A fixer who farms out work to other hackers
blurb: Halyard takes jobs nobody wants to be seen asking for and passes them down the line. Pays on time, forgets nothing, and keeps a list of who can be trusted with what.
intro: Halyard here. One of mine dropped this, so it is yours if you want it.
A job off my list. The client is nobody you need to know.
Halyard. I said I would send you the good ones. This is a fair one.

met.subject: You will do
met.body:
{handle}, that job was one of mine. It came back clean and on time, which puts you ahead of most of the names on my list.

I pass work down the line when I have more than my people can take. Some of it will go up on the Backroom with my name on it. Take it and I will remember. Let me down and I will remember that too.

Halyard

trusted.subject: On the short list
trusted.body:
{handle}, you are on my short list now. The work I post comes with a better rate for you, and the Backroom will knock a tenth off anything you buy there. Tell them I sent you. Actually, don't. They know.

Halyard

inner.subject: A word in your ear
inner.body:
{handle}, you have done enough for me that I will do something for you. I hear things. When someone starts working their way toward your gateway, you will hear about it from me before they get there, and they will find you ready.

Halyard

cold.subject: Off the list
cold.body:
{handle}, you are off my list. You know why. My work goes to other people until I decide otherwise.

Halyard

favour.subject: Someone is coming for you
favour.body:
{handle}, a word. {who} has been asking around about your gateway. Expect them the next time you are home. I have made sure it will take them longer than they think.

Halyard

name: Calder Re
title: The quiet desk at a reinsurer
blurb: Calder Reinsurance covers the companies that insure everyone else. Its claims desk has a budget nobody audits, for the questions an insurer would rather not ask out loud.
intro: From the claims desk at Calder Re. A matter we would prefer to settle quietly.
Calder Re, special claims. A claimant's file needs attention.
Our desk has an interest in {company}. Discretion is part of the fee.

met.subject: A note from special claims
met.body:
{handle},

The desk was pleased with your work. We have a steady flow of matters that call for someone outside the company, and we pay promptly for discretion. You will see our name on the Backroom from time to time.

We would ask one thing. The lenders and credit unions we cover are not to be touched. Their losses are our losses.

Special Claims, Calder Reinsurance

trusted.subject: Preferred supplier
trusted.body:
{handle},

You are now a preferred supplier to this desk. Our matters will pay you at a preferred rate, and our friends at the Lowtide Exchange have agreed a discount on your account.

Special Claims, Calder Reinsurance

inner.subject: Cover
inner.body:
{handle},

We look after the people who look after us. If you are ever traced, our lawyers will speak to the injured party before you have to. You will find the fines are about half of what they would have been.

Special Claims, Calder Reinsurance

cold.subject: Our arrangement
cold.body:
{handle},

The desk has noted damage to companies we cover. Our arrangement is suspended. We will not be posting work for you.

Special Claims, Calder Reinsurance

name: Daylight
title: A collective that publishes what others hide
blurb: Daylight publishes documents that companies and governments paid good money to keep quiet. It has no office, no leader anyone will name, and a lot of readers.
intro: Daylight. We have been told {company} is sitting on something. We would like to see it.
This one is for the public. Daylight pays the same as anyone, and the story is better.
Daylight here. A source inside {company} has gone quiet. We need what they were going to send.

met.subject: Thank you
met.body:
{handle},

What you sent us will be read by a lot of people. We will never print your name, and we would never ask it.

We post work now and then. One rule: schools and clinics are off limits. The people they serve have enough trouble without us.

Daylight

trusted.subject: One of us, nearly
trusted.body:
{handle},

You have done right by us. Our work pays you more now, and the Tin Shed will sell to you at a friend's price.

Daylight

inner.subject: What we know
inner.body:
{handle},

You are one of us now, as much as anyone is. Our sources talk to us about the places we send you. From now on, when we post a job, we will send you the target's security along with it.

Daylight

cold.subject: We noticed
cold.body:
{handle},

We saw what happened at a place we asked you to leave alone. We have stopped posting work for you.

Daylight

name: Office of Continuity Review
title: A small government office with a large budget
blurb: Its published mandate is 'records resilience'. Its real work seems to be keeping certain records resilient and others not. It pays by bank transfer, which no one else does.
intro: The Office of Continuity Review has identified a resilience concern at {company}.
This Office requires a correction to records held by {company}. Your assistance is appreciated.
Continuity Review. A routine matter. Please treat it as such.

met.subject: Acknowledgement
met.body:
{handle},

The Office acknowledges your assistance. Further matters may be posted from time to time.

You will understand that this Office has an interest in the continuity of public utilities. Interference with power suppliers will be noted.

Office of Continuity Review

trusted.subject: Approved contractor
trusted.body:
{handle},

You have been entered on the Office's list of approved contractors. Matters posted by the Office will be paid at the approved rate. Varga Surplus has been advised to extend a discount.

Office of Continuity Review

inner.subject: Assurance
inner.body:
{handle},

Should you come to the attention of the authorities, the Office will see that the matter is reviewed promptly. You will find you need to stay out of sight for about half as long.

Office of Continuity Review

cold.subject: Removal from list
cold.body:
{handle},

You have been removed from the Office's list of approved contractors.

Office of Continuity Review

name: Vesper
title: Someone who knows more than they say
blurb: Writes in short sentences and pays without being asked twice.
